Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 22 Feb 2000, Madman2001 wrote:
> When announcing her action of rummaging thru the ash heap, does
> Carlotta also have to announce the card she will be attempting to
> retrieve?
Yes.

> Or must she only announce the "target" card after the action
> is successful?

Nope. You announce everything about an action when it is taken, in
virtually all circumstances (barring the obvious one of political actions,
which is clearly defined in the rules).

--

James Coupe
